title: time of sync on xDrip and AAPS 3.1.0.3-dev-f dont match
symptom: The time between sensor readings is not synchronized between xDrip and AAPS even with Smoothing disabled. AAPS reading from xDrip shows different timestamps, with BG every 6 minutes instead of 5, causing AAPS to not work between readings.
cause: The issue is caused by data arriving every 6 minutes instead of 5 minutes or less, likely due to OOP2 reading every 2 minutes (3 readings = 6 minutes) or a Bluetooth issue.
fix: The issue was fixed in the newest version of AAPS. For users with 6-minute data, the maintainer advised resolving the primary issue by ensuring data arrives every 5 minutes or less, possibly by asking xDrip developers about OOP2 issues.
evidence_quote: Until now its working fine, the issue was fixed at newest version. thanks
